title: ConsentAttribute
description: The scope of consent that is used to manage consent for users.

id.description: The unique ID of this consent scope.

category.description: The top level category used for organizing scopes.

subcategory.description: The a secondary level category used for organizing scopes.

label.description: The display label for this scope when rendered to a user.

org_id.description: If this attribute is custom to a specific organization.

status.description: The status of this consent attribute.

sensitivity.description: The level of sensitivity for this scope.

visible.description: If the scope should be visible to users when granting consent.
